title.narrative: Strengthening Biosphere Reserve Networks and Exploring Geopark Development in Central Africa

description.narrative: This workplan will strengthen the management and governance of existing biosphere reserves, support the expansion of the World Network of Biosphere Reserves, and explore the development of the first UNESCO Global Geopark in Central Africa. It will provide technical assistance for new nominations and/or periodic reviews, and bring together site managers, national focal points and authorities through capacity-building and network coordination activities to discuss how the global vision for biosphere reserves adopted in Hangzhou can be translated into practical actions at national and subregional levels. Key activities include technical assistance for nominations and/or periodic reviews, geopark exploration, support to regional network coordination, and environmental awareness campaigns
